source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set Time sync with NTP server
2. Change NTP server date and time
3. Check UBB IP is available after flashed BMC Firmware

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System date and time will change and match the NTP server date and time.
2. System date and time will follow NTP server date and time if NTP server changes.
3. Checking there is no BMC network setting change and system can still ping to Virtual nic.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: curl + BMC creds + reachable NTP server address
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: echo "BEFORE"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol | jq .NTP; NEW_NTP="${NTP_SERVER:?operator must set a reachable NTP server (host or IP) for the BMC}"; echo "PATCH -> NTPServers=[$NEW_NTP]"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -X PATCH -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"NTP":{"NTPServers":["$NEW_NTP"],"ProtocolEnabled":true}}' https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; echo "AFTER"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol | jq .NTP; echo "--- DateTime read-back ---"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/DateTime | jq .DateTime
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: BEFORE/AFTER of /redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol .NTP + DateTime read-back; user confirms NTP applied + time tracks. Agent runs on agent host per R5. Path per 11/12.RestAPI.
deepseek_columns.risk: STATE-CHANGING: patches BMC NTPServers; use reachable NTP + verify. Approval required (R6); keep PARTIAL.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Partial NTP subset; omits firmware/UBB/Virtual NIC scope and tracking proof.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: PACKAGE / CHANGED but flags UBB/Virtual-NIC ambiguity.

original_test_intent: The row mixes NTP configuration/tracking with post-BMC-firmware UBB-IP and Virtual-NIC network persistence, without defining whether a firmware flash is required or how UBB maps to Virtual NIC.
original_method: Configure NTP and alter server time, but also apparently flash BMC firmware and test a separate network path.
manual_activity: After source correction, engineer approves NTP and any separate firmware/update plan; the agent may execute approved software configuration/evidence collection.
required_inputs: Definition of UBB IP and Virtual NIC
Whether/which BMC firmware flash is required
safety_requirements: Do not flash firmware merely to satisfy an unexplained NTP step.
Do not alter lab NTP time without isolating affected clients and authentication impact.
No automatic retry; preserve pre-state and recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Only after correction, run schema-validated NTP tracking and/or a separately approved firmware-network persistence workflow.
Do not infer UBB mapping, flash firmware or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Select/split scope, supply safe stimuli/update contract and approve recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: NTP PATCH is only a partial candidate; insecure TLS, malformed shell JSON expansion and lack of tracking/rollback make it non-runnable, and it cannot cover firmware/UBB/Virtual NIC.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No final method until the owner separates or aligns NTP tracking and firmware/network persistence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All three procedure steps, three criteria, script and 10/5 minutes remain as source facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split into (1) trusted NTP configuration/tracking with controlled time change and rollback and (2) separately governed BMC firmware/network-persistence verification if intended.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform NTP, Virtual NIC/UBB and firmware-update documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes an undefined destructive dependency from the time-sync test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents NTP read-back from falsely covering firmware/network persistence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Time jumps can break authentication/log ordering; firmware flash can brick management.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve two separate plans, but completion of one must not claim the other; Master Source remains unchanged.
expected_evidence: If selected: signed firmware/update/recovery and network persistence evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items/Test Set identify NTP, but Procedure step 3 introduces BMC firmware flashing and UBB IP, while Criteria 3 refers to Virtual NIC without defining equivalence or update lifecycle.

blocked_analysis.analysis: NTP tracking and firmware/network persistence are materially different operations, one potentially destructive; selecting or combining them by inference is unsafe and semantically invalid.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes PACKAGE to BLOCKED because the primary destructive scope remains unresolved.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Specifies a safe split and prevents unsupported firmware action.

review_improvement: Separates ordinary time synchronization from destructive firmware and unrelated network persistence coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: An NTP server change cannot establish post-flash network persistence, and a firmware flash is neither necessary nor safe to infer from an NTP title; the owner must define two distinct lifecycles.
